Founder's Message

At Ruichen Textile, everything we do is built on a single promise — that your fabric order is handled with the same care you would give it yourself. Based in Shaoxing's Keqiao district, the world's largest textile trading hub, we have direct access to hundreds of specialist mills across every major fabric category.

My approach is straightforward: no middlemen, no hand-offs, no surprises. From the moment you share a swatch or a specification, I personally oversee every step — mill selection, 1:1 replication, quality inspection, and container consolidation — until the goods are on their way to your door. You deal with one person who is fully accountable.

Whether you are a growing brand placing your first overseas order or an established buyer optimising your supply chain, I am committed to making the process transparent, reliable, and genuinely effortless. I look forward to earning your trust — one shipment at a time.

Tony Zhang

Founder & General Manager, Ruichen Textile

Our Services

Four capabilities. One contact. Your fabric supply chain — handled end to end.

01

1:1 Fabric Replication

Have a fabric you love but can't re-source? Send a physical swatch. We analyse the exact construction, match it with the right mill, and return a prototype for your approval — before a single metre of bulk is produced.

✓ Perfect Match

GSM, composition, weave structure, and hand-feel — all replicated.

✓ Pantone Lab Dips

Colour-accurate dye lots submitted for approval before bulk dyeing.

✓ 7–10 Day Proto

Prototype returned in one to two weeks. Zero obligation to proceed.

02

Multi-Mill Sourcing

No single factory excels at everything. We work with a network of specialist mills — each the best in their category — and consolidate your order into one seamless purchase. You get factory-direct quality without managing multiple suppliers.

Woven & Denim Knits & Jersey Printed & Digital Technical / Active Linen & Natural Fibres Sustainable / GRS
03

Container Consolidation

Sourcing from multiple mills shouldn't mean multiple shipments. We receive goods from each supplier at our Shaoxing hub, inspect them together, and load everything into one FCL container — one invoice, one shipment, one contact.

💡 Clients typically save 25–40% on freight by consolidating 3+ fabric types into a single 40HQ container.
04

Pre-Shipment Quality Control

Every order is inspected at our hub before it reaches the container. We verify GSM against spec, check colorfastness, measure shrinkage, and review handle and appearance — so the only surprises you get are good ones.

GSM Verification

Weight tested against approved spec on every roll.

Colorfastness

Wash and rub tests to detect dye issues before shipping.

Shrinkage & Hand

Dimensional stability checked; feel verified against approved sample.

🌏 Our Journey into Global Collaboration

Built on Craft.
Growing Toward the World.

We've spent years perfecting fabric sourcing and replication for China's most demanding domestic garment factories. Now, we're ready to bring that same dedication — and a spirit of genuine partnership — to the global stage.

A note from Tony — honestly.

Our roots are in domestic trade. For years, we've partnered with garment factories across China, matching fabrics with precision and shipping thousands of meters of material without a single dispute. That track record is real — and it's the foundation we stand on.

International trade is a new chapter for us. We don't have a wall of overseas client logos to show you. What we do have is deep expertise, a reliable mill network, honest pricing, and a genuine desire to grow with our first global partners — not just for them. If you're willing to take that journey together, we'll make it worth your trust.

FAQ

Common questions regarding our sourcing and production process.

Yes, this is our specialty. Send us your physical swatch or detailed specifications. We'll identify the correct mill and return a 1:1 prototype for your approval before bulk production.
Bulk production never begins without your approval of the prototype. Before shipping, we conduct pre-shipment inspections (GSM, shrinkage, colorfastness) and support third-party inspectors like SGS or ITS.
Our standard MOQ is 1,000m per fabric type. If you have a consolidated order with multiple items, we can often work with you on flexible quantities.
We generally accept T/T (30% deposit, 70% balance before shipment). L/C is available for large orders with established clients.
